architecture: Short straight triangular three-wire NiTi bundle inside a flexible positive-pressure annular cuff: an outer pressure-reacting restraint and an inner compliant membrane press inward on a dry wire lumen. The pressure supply communicates with the annulus, not directly with interwire contacts.

design_values.selection_logic: Smallest triangular contact network with visible outer wires; do not generalize a negative result to a different intended packing without a coverage argument.
Inventory-dependent example; choose the available characterized NiTi lot and measure actual diameter.
Optional thinner stock to expose force/curvature tradeoff if primary is unsafe or exceeds load-cell capacity.
Short optical/mechanical gauge candidate; finalize from bend-fixture clearance, curvature uniformity, sensor field of view and sleeve rating.
A minimum repeatability screen only; later validation cycle-life requirement must be separately specified.
Minimum perturbation count required by the S02 work order; actual rates TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN from calibrated actuator and thermal response.

design_values.unit: ambient differential, low nonzero, higher approved
design_values.selection_logic: Adaptive screen rather than full DOE; actual pressure levels TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN from rated assembly and leak proof.

geometry_and_material_state.packing: Nominal straight close-packed triangular centers, no intentional helical lay; actual contacts and orientation must be imaged/metrologized.
geometry_and_material_state.curvature_orientation: Record bend plane relative to triangle so actual tensile-side y_max is measured.
geometry_and_material_state.straight_vs_precurved: Start straight, ENGINEERING_STARTING_POINT; record initial curvature and do not straighten a preformed wire by unmeasured force.
geometry_and_material_state.NiTi_lot_and_phase: TO_BE_MEASURED: heat/lot, transformation temperatures, surface finish, training state and single-wire cyclic response at pilot temperature.
geometry_and_material_state.axial_prestrain: No deliberate prestrain initially, ENGINEERING_STARTING_POINT; unavoidable assembly strain measured. Additional preset only after a separate single-wire safety check and explicit record.
geometry_and_material_state.end_constraints: One common reference end; distal wire ends individually guided and instrumented outside the pressurized active section to permit and measure relative axial movement. A matched all-fixed control checks boundary-condition effects. Clamp motion is independently tracked.
geometry_and_material_state.pressure_envelope: Flexible annular bladder/cuff with separate inner membrane and outer pressure-reacting layer; component model, rated pressure, seal and feedthrough design TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN and documented before energizing.
geometry_and_material_state.optical_access: Transparent optical path through both pressure layers is a feasibility hypothesis, not assumed. Markers on adjacent wires and membrane are tested under actual pressure; if visibility fails, a validated alternate channel is required.

load_plan.pressure: Ambient differential baseline, then one low and one higher nonzero pressure level selected by human from certified component ratings, proof/leak tests and an independently observed response; no final pressure value specified. Chamber p is not interwire normal force.
load_plan.bending: Displacement-controlled symmetric pure-bending or four-point-bending fixture where feasible, with actual local curvature measured rather than inferred from actuator displacement.
load_plan.curvature: Adaptive staircase from below the batch-specific single-wire transformation estimate to the lesser of independently established NiTi integrity and membrane/fixture limits; no final maximum until safety evidence exists.
load_plan.rates: At least a slow and a faster attainable rate or a load-hold dwell comparison, both logged as actual local strain-rate histories; values selected after equipment and thermal pilot characterization.
load_plan.cycle_history: Record every assembly, preconditioning, loading, unloading and dwell event. Do not erase early-cycle training as a nuisance.
load_plan.temperature: Measure ambient and at least one bundle-adjacent or wire-surface thermal channel; verify its lag against a single-wire reference.

safety_and_stop_limits.hard_pressure_limit: TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN from exact cuff/tubing/fitting ratings and proof test; no literature cable pressure may be transferred as a rating.
safety_and_stop_limits.hard_wire_limit: TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN from selected NiTi lot safe-strain/fatigue information and single-wire tests.
safety_and_stop_limits.hard_membrane_limit: TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN from pressure, strain, leak and optical-window characterization.
other_abort_signals: sensor short/failure that defeats safety monitoring
temperature excursion beyond approved lot envelope

coverage_limit: A three-wire positive result establishes feasibility only for the tested configuration. A negative result can kill the intended MP1 coupling core only after the human owner documents that the tested strain, pressure/contact, temperature and boundary envelope brackets the proposed actual bundle; otherwise route to NARROW or REDESIGN.
